### Stacy Taffet Appointed to Kohl's Board of Directors


10/29/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/271435555/files/doc_news/Stacy-Taffet-Appointed-to-Kohls-Board-of-Directors-2026.pdf)


*Taffet, Chief Growth and Marketing Officer for The Hershey Company, brings more than 20 years of consumer brands, marketing, and strategic leadership experience*


MENOMONEE FALLS, Wis.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Kohl’s (NYSE: KSS) today announced that Stacy Taffet has joined its Board of Directors (the "Board") as an independent director. Ms. Taffet, Chief Growth and Marketing Officer for The Hershey Company, brings more than 20 years of leadership experience at large consumer goods brands, including 15 years of progressive leadership at PepsiCo. With deep experience driving transformation strategies and growth initiatives, Ms. Taffet will add additional depth to Kohl's Board.


"We are pleased to welcome Stacy to the Board," said Wendy Arlin, Board Chair. "Throughout her career, she's been instrumental in driving meaningful growth, innovation, and value creation at large, global consumer companies. She has a strong focus on putting the customer at the center of key decisions and strategies. She will be an excellent addition to our Board as we continue to work with Kohl's leadership team to drive transformation at Kohl's and create value for our shareholders."


Ms. Taffet's appointment is part of the ongoing Board refreshment process at Kohl's, which continues to bring in relevant, experienced leaders.


Ms. Taffet has been appointed to a term expiring at Kohl's 2027 annual shareholders' meeting and is expected to stand for election by Kohl's shareholders at that time. She will initially serve on the Board's Audit Committee. With Ms. Taffet's appointment, the Board consists of 9 directors, 8 of whom are independent.


"I'm honored to join the Kohl's Board," said Taffet. "Kohl's is a storied retailer with an important place in the retail industry. There is great opportunity for the future, and I'm excited to join the Board at a time when much of that opportunity is still ahead of us. I am committed to being a productive voice in the boardroom, supporting growth strategies, and delivering shareholder value."


**About Stacy Taffet**


Taffet has been Chief Growth and Marketing Officer for The Hershey Company since April 2025, where she is responsible for driving transformative growth and marketing strategies across the company's expanding snacks portfolio. She manages creative investment, brand reach and relevance, innovation, research and development, and brand reputation. She has more than 20 years of leadership experience as a global consumer packaged goods executive, including a distinguished career at PepsiCo spanning multiple brand portfolios, including Senior Vice President of Beverage Portfolio Strategy and Marketing. Prior to PepsiCo, Taffet began her career in marketing at American Express Company. Taffet has a Master of Business Administration from Harvard Business School.
